cards.name: Hunting Time
cards.text:
250% Piercing Damage to all enemies.
Gain Maximum Reload.
cards.notes: Piercing Damage: ignores enemy shields (not modeled), otherwise normal damage

cards.name: Rapid Fire
cards.text: 100% Damage.

cards.name: Illusion of Golden Daffodils
cards.text: 100% Shield.

cards.name: Firing Preparation
cards.text:
Create 1 Ballista card(s).
At the start of the turn, create 1 Ballista card(s).

cards.name: Firing Preparation I
cards.text:
Create 1 Ballista card(s).
At the start of the turn, create 1 Ballista card(s) with a 50% chance to additionally create 1 more.

cards.name: Firing Preparation II
cards.text:
Create 1 Piercing Ballista card(s).
At the start of the turn, create 1 Piercing Ballista card(s).

cards.name: Firing Preparation III
cards.text:
Create 1 Enhanced Ballista card(s).
At the start of the turn, create 1 Enhanced Ballista card(s).

cards.name: Firing Preparation IV
cards.text:
Create 1 Giant Ballista card(s).
At the start of the turn, create 1 Giant Ballista card(s).

cards.name: Firing Preparation V
cards.text:
Create 1 Shelling Ballista card(s).
At the start of the turn, create 1 Shelling Ballista card(s).

cards.name: Repose
cards.text:
100% Shield.
Draw 2 card(s) from other combatant.

cards.name: Repose I
cards.text: Draw 2 other Combatant's card(s).

cards.name: Repose II
cards.text:
Draw 2 other combatant card(s).
If that card is a Skill Card, 1 Reload.

cards.name: Repose III
cards.text:
150% Shield.
Draw 2 card(s) of other Combatants.
Decrease Cost of 1 of those cards by 1 for 1 turn.

cards.name: Repose IV
cards.text:
150% Shield.
1 Reload equal to number of other combatant Skill Cards in hand.

cards.name: Repose V
cards.text:
150% Shield.
Discard all other combatant cards in hand.
1 Reload equal to that number.

cards.name: Pendant of Resolution
cards.text: When another combatant uses Skill Card, 1 Reload.

cards.name: Pendant of Resolution I
cards.text: When using a Skill Card, 1 Reload.

cards.name: Pendant of Resolution II
cards.text:
When another combatant uses Skill Card, 1 Reload.
If 3 are used, at the start of the next turn, create 1 Micro Ballista card(s).

cards.name: Pendant of Resolution III
cards.text: For 1 turn(s), when a card is used, 1 Reload

cards.name: Pendant of Resolution IV
cards.text:
When another combatant uses a Skill Card, 1 Reload.
50% Chance to gain additional 1 Reload.

cards.name: Pendant of Resolution V
cards.text: Reload 2.

cards.name: Sir Kowalski
cards.text: Choose 1 Ballista card in hand, +100% Damage Amount until activated. Draw 1.

cards.name: Sir Kowalski I
cards.text: Choose 1 Ballista card in hand, +150% Damage Amount until activated. Draw 2.

cards.name: Sir Kowalski II
cards.text:
Skill Draw 1.
Increase Damage Amount of Ballista by 30% for 1 turn.

cards.name: Sir Kowalski III
cards.text:
Draw 2.
When drawing a Skill card, create 1 Ballista.

cards.name: Sir Kowalski IV
cards.text:
+250% Damage amount of 1 random Ballista Card in hand.
Exhaust after activation.

cards.name: Sir Kowalski V
cards.text:
Select and Exhaust 1 Ballista in hand.
Create 2 Ballista, decrease Damage Amount of those cards by 25% until activated.

cards.name: Bombardment Prep
cards.text:
Increase max stack of Reload by 1.
2 Reload.

cards.name: Ballista
cards.text: At the end of the turn, 150% Extra Attack to a random enemy.

cards.name: Piercing Ballista
cards.text:
At the end of the turn, 200% Piercing Damage to a random enemy.
If the target has Shield, +50% Damage.
cards.notes: Piercing Damage: ignores enemy shields (not modeled), otherwise normal damage

cards.name: Enhanced Ballista
cards.text: At the end of the turn, 200% Extra Attack to a random enemy, +30% Critical Chance.

cards.name: Giant Ballista
cards.text: At the end of the turn, 150% Extra Attack to all enemies.

cards.name: Shelling Ballista
cards.text: At the end of the turn, 100% × 2 Extra Attack to random enemies.

cards.name: Micro Ballista
cards.text: At the end of the turn, 40% Extra Attack to a random enemy.

potentials.name: Epiphany Bonus
potentials.text: When entering Chaos, obtain 1 random Rare Card with an activated Epiphany.

potentials.name: Basic Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Basic Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Common Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Common Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text: Add to Rapid Fire card effect: 20% chance to create 1 random Ballista card in hand.

potentials.name: Unique Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Unique Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text:
+5% Damage for Veronica's Rapid Fire.
If Veronica is Attack is greater than 500, an additional +5% to that value.

potentials.name: Divine Epiphany Adaptation
potentials.text: Increases the chance for a Divine Epiphany to appear by 25%.

potentials.name: Unique Stat Upgrade
potentials.text:
If Veronica's Attack is greater than 700, +5% Ballista Shot damage.
For every 40 Attack exceeding that value, +1% (up to an additional +10%).

manifestEgo.name: Sleeping Memory
manifestEgo.text: Bombardment Prep card's Reload is increased by 2.

manifestEgo.name: Awakening Memory
manifestEgo.text:
Whenever an ally uses a Targeting Attack Card, apply 1 Floral Scent to the target.
Floral Scent: +20% Damage taken from Ballista.
This monster becomes a Ballista activation target.
Floral Scent is removed when applied to another target.

manifestEgo.name: Vivid Memory
manifestEgo.text: Add to Hunting Time card effect: Create 1 random Ballista card in hand.

manifestEgo.name: Inner Memory
manifestEgo.text: Increase max stack of Reload by 1.

manifestEgo.name: Complete Memory
manifestEgo.text: Increase the level of [Basic Card Upgrade], [Unique Card Upgrade], and [Common Card Upgrade] in Potentials by 3.

manifestEgo.name: Liberated Memory
manifestEgo.text: At the start of the turn, inflicts 1 Mark on all enemies inflicted with Floral Scent.
